acceptance: AT-ops-50 source phases implemented; assigned unfiltered CLI proof and whole R0.11 acceptance remain pending.
implementedOwnerBehavior: Added inspectPending and resumePending signatures over existing ModelAdmissionRecordV1 types only.

inspectPending selects same-account/current-UTC-day denied uncharged rows with zero native sends, no terminal acknowledgement, endedAt null, durable retryAt, measured threshold or measured owner-pause reason, and autonomous classes only; SQL orders event/continuation, quiet-tick, repair/replay.

Fresh eligible lower-priority reserve is persisted as uncharged OPTIONAL_WORK_PAUSED with the measured pending head wake. The mutation statement rechecks the selected pending head after the existing advisory lock; higher or equal-priority work may proceed.

resumePending returns changed or charged history idempotently before queue checks, refuses wrong heads and noncurrent-day rows, validates the open matching budget binding, re-evaluates the existing ModelAdmissionPolicy, and mutates only the selected same row under the advisory lock and snapshot compare.

Eligible resume budget counters depend only on the conditional denied-and-uncharged row transition RETURNING. No frozen request, cost, hash, day, native count, or acknowledgement fields are changed. No provider send permit is issued.

phaseObservations.persist-deferred-work: Real accounting fixture records baseline unreflected upper-bound reservation, then deliberately inserts repair, event, quiet-tick, continuation at a measured threshold; it checks durable denied records and tier ordering without caller sorting.
phaseObservations.owner-queue-readback: A separate ModelAdmission.withTest reopen reads the owner queue, proves wrong-head CONFLICT without row or ledger mutation, then attempts a fresh repair at 20/20 with measured costs and existing reservation; the numerical request fits common 60/70 limits, but owner persists OPTIONAL_WORK_PAUSED without charge or lease and preserves prior rows.
phaseObservations.ordered-resume-under-headroom: A separate reopen resumes the owner-selected event/continuation heads at 58% while repair remains deferred, checks same-row idempotent replay without a second charge, then at 59.998% proves quiet-tick RESERVATION_THRESHOLD from shared usage plus outstanding upper bounds. At 59%, fresh event and continuation requests remain eligible ahead of quiet/repair; final queue retains quiet before repair.
